areas.title: Environment Agency areas
areas.description: Include any of these published EA area names or codes. For example, use East Anglia or 52. Names are matched without regard to case. Leave empty to include every area.

keywords.title: Scheme name contains
keywords.description: Include schemes whose names contain at least one of these words or phrases, ignoring case.

minHomesBetterProtected.title: Minimum homes better protected
minHomesBetterProtected.description: Only include schemes with a published count at or above this value. Set it to zero to include all published counts and exclude missing counts.

maxItems.title: Maximum output rows
maxItems.description: Maximum number of schemes to save in this run. In monitoring mode, eligible rows beyond the limit remain eligible for later runs.

onlyNew.title: Monitor new and changed schemes
onlyNew.description: Report each matching scheme on first sight and when its published fields change compared with the last saved version.

stateKey.title: Monitoring state key
stateKey.description: Reuse this key for related runs. Use a different key for a separate baseline. Enter 1 to 50 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.
